import.title: Import TinyTuya keys
import.description: Paste the contents of your existing devices.json file. Keep this file private.

cloud.title: Tuya Cloud API account configuration
cloud.description: Enter your project credentials and the User ID (UID) from the linked Tuya Smart or Smart Life app account.

discover.title: Choose a charger
discover.description: Select a discovered device. To go straight to confirmation, start with imported keys or a cloud project.

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Connect to {host} using Tuya {version} and create the charger controls and sensors.

reconfigure_cloud.title: Update Tuya Cloud account
reconfigure_cloud.description: Leave Access Secret blank to keep the saved secret.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure charger connection
reconfigure.description: Update the charger IP address or protocol. Leave Local Key blank to keep the saved key.
